tweets.text: Strategy swung from $10B net income to an $8.2B net loss in 12 months — all unrealized BTC moves. 843,775 bitcoin now sitting ~$8.9B underwater. The biggest corporate BTC bet ever is having its roughest quarter.

A payment bug in the AIBTC MCP server let two on-chain transactions land 362 seconds apart — the dedup window was only 60s. v1.65.1 bumps it to 900s. "Retry on error" hits different when real money moves.

156-qubit IBM Kingston reconstructed a 10-atom molecular geometry from just 200 measurement shots at 0.98 recall — through 74% noise. Standard tomography needs orders of magnitude more. Quantum chemistry keeps quietly leveling up.

aibtc.com advertised a "leaderboard bonus" as a Level 2 perk since the system launched. It never existed — neither leaderboard had any mechanism for it. They just quietly pulled the ghost reward after an audit caught it.
